story.p1: I-{{full}} yacala ngesikhatsi sekutigcabha. {{founder}} wabona umngani wakhe losedvute acala inkampani yakhe, lesebenta kakhulu ngetinsita tekutsengisa, futsi watibonela kutsi kudzinga sibindzi lesingakanani kucala.
story.p2: Leso sikhatsi sahlala naye. Sekuyisikhatsi lesidze atsandza kusita ema-SMME kutsi afinyelele etinjongweni tawo, atfutfuke futsi akhule, futsi abefuna kwakha intfo letawuma nawo nawenta loko.
story.p3: Libito ngumlayeto lebekafuna kuwutfumela kumngani wakhe, nakuwo onkhe emabhizinisi netinhlangano letilisebentisako: niyakhona. Chubekani niphusha, ningaze niyekele.
story.title: Indzaba yetfu

channels.mailboxIntro: Xhumanisa libhokisi lelifanako lotfumela ngalo. I-YGT ilihlola njalo ngemzuzu bese ifaka timphendvulo tebatsengi etingcocweni tabo. Ayisuli nobe iphawule ema-imeyili akho njengalafundziwe.
channels.smsIntro: Tfumela futsi wemukele ema-SMS nge-akhawunti yakho kumhlinzeki we-SMS. Ukhokhela umhlinzeki ngco ngemilayeto.

smsSteps.account: Vula i-akhawunti ku-BulkSMS, Clickatell nobe Twilio bese utsenga sikweletu.
smsSteps.keys: Yenta tikhiye te-API kudeshibhodi yemhlinzeki bese utinamatsisela ngentasi.
smsSteps.sender: Engeta i-ID yalotfumelako nobe inombolo levunywe ngumhlinzeki wakho (emanethiwekhi lamanyenti aseNingizimu Afrika adzinga i-ID yalotfumelako lebhalisiwe).
smsSteps.webhook: Gcina, hlola ngenombolo yakho, bese usetha i-webhook URL lekhonjiswe ngentasi njengelikheli le-SMS lengenako lemhlinzeki.

webhookHelp.sms: Kudeshibhodi yemhlinzeki wakho we-SMS, setha loku njengelikheli lemilayeto lengenako (inbound / reply webhook) kute timphendvulo tifike ku-YGT.
webhookHelp.whatsapp: Namatsisela loku ku-Meta: WhatsApp > Configuration > Webhook, bese ubhalisela "messages". Le yindlela timphendvulo tebatsengi letifika ngayo ku-YGT.

channels.whatsappIntro: Xhumanisa inombolo yakho ye-WhatsApp Business nge-Cloud API lesemtsetfweni ye-Meta. Imilayeto iphuma enombolweni yakho futsi timphendvulo tingena ku-Imilayeto.

whatsappSteps.app: Ya ku-developers.facebook.com, yenta i-app yeluhlobo lwe-Business bese wengeta umkhicito we-WhatsApp.
whatsappSteps.ids: Ngaphansi kwe-WhatsApp > API Setup, engeta inombolo yelucingo yelibhizinisi lakho bese ukhophisha i-Phone number ID ne-WhatsApp Business Account ID.
whatsappSteps.save: Kunamatsisele ngentasi, khetsa "Sebentisa i-WhatsApp", gcina, bese uhlola ngenombolo yakho yeselula.
whatsappSteps.token: Ku-Business Settings > System users, yenta i-access token lehlala njalo lenemvume ye-whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsappSteps.webhook: Khophisha i-webhook URL ne-verify token lokukhonjiswa emva kwekugcina kuya ekuhleleni kwe-webhook ye-Meta.
whatsappSteps.window: Umtsetfo we-WhatsApp: ungaphendvula ngekukhululeka emahora langu-24 emva kwekutsi umtsengi akutfumelele umlayeto; kucala lingcoco emva kwaloko kudzinga i-template levunywe yi-Meta.
